# Orgo

Orgo provides cloud computers that agents can create, control, automate, and manage through an API.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/orgo/.

## Actions

- **Control Pointer**: Perform one pointer action on a running Orgo computer.
- **Create Computer**: Create and automatically start a virtual computer in an accessible workspace.
- **Delete Computer**: Permanently delete one Orgo computer and its data.
- **Execute Code**: Execute arbitrary Bash or Python code on an Orgo computer.
- **Get Computer** (read-only): Get current details and status for one Orgo computer.
- **Get Screenshot** (read-only): Capture the current display of a running Orgo computer for visual inspection before deciding on mouse or keyboard input.
- **List Templates** (read-only): List either templates owned by the connected account or Orgo-maintained curated templates.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): List workspaces accessible to the connected Orgo key, including the computers in each workspace.
- **Run Computer Agent**: Run one non-streaming computer-use agent task on a running Orgo computer.
- **Send Keyboard Input**: Send either literal text or one key or key combination to the current keyboard focus on a running Orgo computer.
- **Set Computer Power State**: Start, stop, or restart one Orgo computer after explicit user confirmation.
